purpose: Exercise the actual CUDA Interaction_Forces consumer and stress-rate writeback using one fixed wall and one soil particle; no copied CUDA algorithm, MLS, mirror reconstruction or integration.
protected: Do not alter production source, canonical programs, retained fixture/source/proof files, formal inputs, server bundles or outputs. Root must protect and authorize any fresh GPU Debug project build separately.

scope.correction_matrix: identity (injected, not solved from a rank-deficient two-particle cloud)

gates: True CUDA kernel output is downloaded. Pure auxiliary x shear along a z pair has exact zero density rate, pore rate, Ace and ViscDt but nonzero correctly signed rsigma_xz near G*Lxz.
All mathematically zero stress components require exact zero; no original nonzero tolerance can conceal a dropped shear writeback.
Nonzero S/P/R reference bounds retain original Mdbc vector limits: 20/2000/.02 + 2e-5*abs(reference). Trace/pore consistency additionally uses 2e-5*max(1,abs(pore_rate)).
Both signs of normal auxiliary and the corresponding normal-plus-shear have identical rho/pore/Ace/ViscDt/non-shear stress values. Shear sign reversal and normal density/pore sign reversal are exact.
Approaching physical-soil probe has nonzero artificial-viscosity Acez; receding probe has nonzero ViscDt. Auxiliary shear perturbation leaves both routes and non-shear quantities exactly unchanged.
Inputs have zero stress/pore pressure, stationary physical wall and zero TangenVel; unchanged physical velocity/density is checked after every call. No physical-time advance occurs.
build_contract: After root-approved authoritative GPU Debug/Release build, invoke bv_pair_gpu_build_r1.ps1 with -Configuration and -ProductionBuildLog. This new script only compiles the host fixture and links the authoritative project object set, excluding main. It records current source/object/log/library/runtime SHA before/after and archives relevant small source bytes. It cannot independently establish freshness of a caller-supplied production object; root must bind the actual new build receipt. It never builds production or runs a test.
run_contract: Root-reviewed fixture: bv_pair_gpu_r1.exe --out NEW_TEST_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY [--device 0]. Default/no arguments only show help. Directory must not exist; preserve failed records under their original label.

outputs.pairs.csv: 72 rows of actual downloaded wall/soil rates, Ace, ViscDt, six stress-rate components and scalar analytic L references
outputs.completion.json: diagnostic_completed/passed/kernel_calls plus explicit false physical/MLS/integration flags

limits: An injected auxiliary velocity tests the consumer contract, not reconstruction/mirror correctness or wall boundary compatibility.
Two particles cannot establish an MLS/correction-matrix rank, a general affine cloud, mixed-slip mapping, rotating-wall support, or physical convergence.
This is a nonintegrated artificial-viscosity operator diagnostic; no formal/full/restart admission and no notifier.
